content.text: The redline validated cleanly. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 14. INSURANCE. Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
input.rationale: An insurance clause is present (§ 14, p0048), so the rule is not "missing", but it fails the fallback on a material term. The clause carries workers' compensation as required by statute, CGL of USD 1,000,000, E&O of USD 1,000,000 and certificates/evidence on Company request — the E&O limit sits at the fallback (USD 1M) and is acceptable. However, there is no cyber/privacy liability coverage of any amount, and the fallback expressly requires cyber of USD 2,000,000. Cyber cover is material here: "Confidential Information" is defined in p0038 to include Company "data, records ... (including, but not limited to, Company records and information)" obtained by Contractor while performing the Services, and p0007 contemplates Contractor personnel working at Company facilities and accessing Company computer systems. A vendor that handles our data and touches our systems with zero cyber cover falls in walk-away territory under this rule. The minimal edit inserts cyber/privacy liability at the preferred USD 5,000,000, scoped to circumstances where Contractor handles Company data, and leaves the negotiated CGL, E&O, workers' compensation and certificate mechanics untouched; the comment offers the USD 2,000,000 fallback. Noted but not flagged as separate deviations: no CGL aggregate limit is stated (preferred USD 2M aggregate), E&O sits at the fallback USD 1M rather than the preferred USD 2M, and coverage runs only through the term rather than one year thereafter — these are minor sub-elements short of preferred wording.

proposal.summary: Add cyber/privacy liability coverage to the existing insurance clause, since Contractor handles Company data and systems.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Contractor obtains Company data and records and may access our computer systems, so we need cyber/privacy liability cover alongside the existing general liability and E&O coverage; our playbook position is USD 5,000,000 for vendors processing Customer Data. We can accept USD 2,000,000 as a fallback if the higher limit is not commercially available to Contractor.

ops.oldText: with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services
ops.newText: with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), and, where Contractor processes, stores or has access to Company data or Confidential Information, cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least five million dollars ($5,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services
